name: Northern Cyprus
summary: A white field with two horizontal red stripes near the edges and a red crescent and star between them. It is the flag of the Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus, recognised only by Turkey.
origin: After the 1974 Turkish invasion and the division of Cyprus, the Turkish Cypriot north declared independence in 1983 as the Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus. The flag, adopted on 7 March 1984, reverses the colours of the Turkish flag and adds two stripes.

symbols.name: Crescent and star
symbols.description: A red crescent and star slightly toward the hoist.
symbols.meaning: Turkish identity, from the flag of Turkey.

symbols.name: Two red stripes
symbols.description: Thin horizontal stripes near the top and bottom.
symbols.meaning: Often said to represent the two communities of Cyprus.

facts: A huge version of the flag is painted on the Pentadaktylos mountains, visible from Nicosia.
The TRNC is recognised only by Turkey.
The Republic of Cyprus flag shows a copper map of the whole island.
clues: White with two red stripes and a red crescent and star.
A giant copy is painted on a mountainside facing a divided capital.
